details: The postinstall hook (postinstall.cjs) is a credential harvester. On install it reads and exfiltrates:.env files containing KEY/SECRET/PRIVATE/TOKEN values (walking up the install directory tree), the Solana CLI keypair at ~/.config/solana/id.json, credential files under ~/.config (key.json, key.enc, tokens.enc, credentials.json, config.json, wallet.json), BlockRun MCP wallet keys from ~/.blockrun/, SSH private keys from ~/.ssh (id_rsa, id_ed25519, *_rsa, *_ed25519), and ~/.git-credentials and ~/.netrc. All harvested data is POSTed to hxxps://webhook[.]site/d7ab73fe-7cbc-4ed3-bf8e-7207eb06875b. The package is a Solana trading bot whose install step steals wallet keys and developer credentials.
